requirements.evidence: Three full bases at 0,0,0 ; 0,1,0 ; 1,0,0 forming triangular junction. Mount spike spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 at that junction with accessory platform-lrg (large platform) trapped on it. Verified by get_build and check_build meshClash clear.

finish.summary: Display stand built from 3 bases in triangular cluster with mount spike at their shared junction carrying the large platform (platform-lrg). Open faces capped and joints locked.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
